metadata.article_title: Recording of oral evidence on a day-to-day basis.

article.title: Recording of oral evidence on a day-to-day basis.
article.content: The Court shall, as far as possible, ensure that the recording of evidence shall be carried on, on a day-to-day basis until the cross-examination of all the witnesses is complete.
article.html:
4Recording of oral evidence on a day-to-day basis.

Order 15A, Rule 4

The Court shall, as far as possible, ensure that the recording of evidence shall be carried on, on a day-to-day basis until the cross-examination of all the witnesses is complete.
